references.text: The Lord tested Israel in the wilderness to know their heart and see whether they would keep his commandments or not.
God tested Israel with manna in the wilderness to humble them and ultimately do good to them.
The Lord tests his people to know if they love him with all their heart and all their soul.
God tested Israel with manna to see whether they would walk according to his law or not.
At Marah, the Lord tested Israel and gave them statutes and commandments to follow.
The nations were left in the land to test Israel and see if they would keep the way of the Lord.
The Lord allowed the nations to remain to test Israel, those who had not known the wars of Canaan.
Moses delivered the Lord's commandments and statutes to the children of Israel that they should keep them.
